share.title: Yabelana
share.offered: Yenzelwe wena. Bhala eyakho uma uthanda: ayigcinwa neze.
share.read: Faka lokho umsizi {name} akufundile: amafayela owengezile nalokho ukusesha okutholile
share.goes: Isixhumanisi siqukethe izicelo, izimpendulo namafayela enziwe umsizi {name}. Amanothi akho, inkumbulo nokhiye kuhlala lapha.
share.code: Isixhumanisi njengekhodi ye-QR, ukuze usivule ngekhamera yefoni
share.apart: Iboniswa manje kuphela. Yithumele ngenye indlela ehlukile kwesixhumanisi.
share.tooBig: Lokhu kukhulu kakhulu ukwabelana ngakho: isixhumanisi siphatha i-10 MB kuphela.
share.failed: Isixhumanisi asikwazanga ukwenziwa. Hlola uxhumano lwakho bese uzama futhi.
share.notHere: Lesi sixhumanisi senziwe kwenye idivayisi: yiyona kuphela engasishintsha.
share.confirmStop: Yeka ukushicilela? Onesixhumanisi ngeke esakwazi ukusivula.
share.ended: Lesi sixhumanisi sayeka ukuvuleka: {date}. Sibuyekeze ukuze sivuleke futhi.
share.bring: Letha lo msebenzi owabelwe kumsizi {name}? Uba ngomunye wemisebenzi yakho, ongaqhubeka nawo.
share.broughtWith: Umsebenzi owabelwe ulapha. Kungezwe kumakhono akho, ukuze kuboniswe wonke: {skills}.
share.broken: Lesi sixhumanisi asiphelele. Cela osithumele ukuthi asithumele futhi.
share.tooMany: Imizamo eminingi kakhulu. Zama futhi ngemuva kwehora.
share.unreachable: Lokhu akukwazanga ukufinyelelwa. Hlola uxhumano lwakho bese uzama futhi.
share.certified: Izitifiketi zezimpendulo zakho zihamba nakho. Zinophawu lwale divayisi, ngakho okwabelana ngakho kungahlukaniswa futhi kuxhunyaniswe.
